cases.case_label: RP1 exon 4 Alu insertion (c.4052_4053ins328) in Korean IRD patients
cases.disease: Inherited retinal disease (macular dystrophy, cone-rod dystrophy)
cases.mechanism_detail: The recurrent East Asian Alu insertion in RP1 (c.4052_4053ins328), missed in initial exome analysis, was found by MEI-targeted reanalysis in 5 unrelated patients, each compound heterozygous with p.Arg1933*, c.4582_4585del or c.4196del.
cases.quote: A customized grep program developed by our group was also applied to detect Alu insertion in RP1, a common insertion in East Asian.
